page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Right margin carries small "«" line-end marks, which are printer's ornaments, not text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: ius agnati sumus,testatus non est. Depulsio est: Imò mea, qui heres secundus testamento patris sum factus. Quæstio est, u-trorum sit? Ratio est: Pater enim & sibi & filio testamẽtũ scripsit, dum is pupillus esset: quare quę [?] filij fuerũt, testamẽto patris mea fiat necesse est. Infirmatio est rationis: Imò pater sibi scripsit, & secũdum heredem non filio, sed sibi, iussit esse. Quare præter-quam quòd ipsius fuit in testamento, ullius uestrûm esse non potest. Iudicatio: possit' ne quisquam de filij pupilli re testari: an heredes secundi i-psius patrisfamiliâs, non filij quo-

page.notes: Printed "«" marks at each line end in the right margin are ornaments, not transcribed. The printed "|" in "Depulsio|est" is a stray mark, so it was read as "Depulsio est". The "qu̧" before "filij" is a doubtful form (read as quę [?]). The catchword "quo-" is a hyphenated word at the foot right. The signature "k 5" is at the foot left-centre.
